product.sinclair-apc386sx.summary: Desktop PC with a plug-in 386SX processor card and onboard VGA.
product.sinclair-apc386sx.history: The front badge reads “Sinclair APC 386SX by Amstrad”. A specimen labelled APC386SX carries an internal “3386 SX” sticker. Its chassis and processor card support identification as Amstrad’s PC3386SX design sold under the Sinclair brand.
product.sinclair-apc386sx.technical.cpu: The APC specimen record lists 20 MHz. The PC3386SX leaflet also lists 20 MHz, while its user manual’s specification table lists 16 MHz.
product.sinclair-apc386sx.technical.boar: The photographed mainboard is marked Z70921 and DPA1704. The processor card shares its layout and 2600-025P PCB series with the PC3386SX’s MS0196A. The APC specimen carries revision 2 and 3 markings on opposite sides. Full electrical equivalence between the boards remains unverified.
product.sinclair-apc386sx.technical.hard: The photographed unit has four SIMM sockets, Paradise PVGA1A graphics and a Dallas DS1287 clock. Another documented unit has a Seagate ST-157A-1 IDE hard disk. The keyboard uses Amstrad’s own protocol.
product.sinclair-apc386sx.warning: A verified BIOS dump from an identified unit is still needed. Byte-for-byte identity with the PC3386SX remains open and virtual machine creation is disabled.
product.sinclair-apc386sx.technical.acme: APC386SX specimen record and photographs in the ACME archive
product.sinclair-apc386sx.technical.amst: PC3386SX Generation 3 leaflet, user manual and MS0196A processor card
